senses.gloss: f. (פָּרַס) piece, esp. piece of bread, bread.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 4:10">Tosef. Peah IV, 10</cite> <he>עני שנותן פרוטה לקופה ופ׳ לתמחוי</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>פרוטה לתמחוי ופרוטה לקופה</he>, corr. acc.) a poor man that contributes a P’ruṭah to the charity fund or a piece of bread to the public crib.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 33:1">Pesik. R. s. 33</cite> <he>הפ׳</he> the bread (livelihood, v. <cite ref="Q01901"><he>פַּרְנָסָה</he></cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּרוּסוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 5:5">Dem. V, 5</cite> <he>פ׳ פת</he> pieces of bread.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 5:14">Tosef. Ter. V, 14</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:15">Esth. R. to I, 3</cite> (play on <cite ref="Q01913"><he>פָּרָס</he></cite>) <he>שקיבלה את המלכות פ׳ וכ׳</he> she (Persia) obtained rulership piecewise, once in the days of T’radah (Xerxes?), and once in the days of Artaban (the Parthian empire).
